translations.web: He said to him, “Teacher, I have observed all these things from my youth.”
translations.bsb: “Teacher,” he replied, “all these I have kept from my youth.”
translations.kjv: And he answered and said unto him, Master, all these have I observed from my youth.
translations.asv: And he said unto him, Teacher, all these things have I observed from my youth.
